name: KMS encrypt / GenerateDataKey only (negative)
note: IAM-504 fixture matrix: KMS-DECRYPT negative. kms:Encrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey are not decryption capabilities and are not secret-retrieval, so neither KMS-DECRYPT nor DATA-EXFIL fires. Scoped key resource, so no WILDCARD-RESOURCE. Proves the decryption rule keys strictly on kms:Decrypt.
